strategy_roster.name: Zero-lag Volatility-Breakout EMA Trend
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(2 * ema(close,200) - ema(ema(close,200),200),bb_upper(2 * ema(close,200) - ema(ema(close,200),200),20,2)) and roc(ema(close,200),20) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: Zero-lag EMA difference is approximated by 2*EMA(200)-EMA(EMA(200),200) and its StdMultiplier=2 band; a rising 20-bar ROC of the same EMA is the documented slope filter. The 5-minute timeframe and binary/stop controls are unavailable, and the documented optional mid-band cross is expressed as price crossing the Dif mid line.

strategy_roster.name: RD Trend Trigger
strategy_roster.notes: Default Twist mode (oscillator turns up) is mapped to a ROC(15) zero-cross with the documented LowLevel=-50 guard. The custom RD-T3 regression oscillator, T3Length/T3VolumeFactor and 4-hour candle are not expressible, so ROC of close is an explicit substitute.

strategy_roster.name: EMA Crossover Short Focus Trailing Stop
strategy_roster.notes: Directly uses the documented 13/33 EMA relationship for the long side (25 EMA only governs the short exit). TrailDistance 10 and TrailOffset 2 are point distances with no percentage equivalent, so no stop is set.

strategy_roster.name: Moving Average Crossover
strategy_roster.notes: Uses the documented ShortLength 9 and LongLength 21 SMA cross, with the opposite cross as the reversal exit. The 1-minute CandleType is not configurable here and the docs state no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Fractal WPR
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is rebuilt as the close's position in the 14-bar Donchian range, scaled x-100, with the documented HighLevel -30 / LowLevel -70 crossings (Direct mode). WprPeriod has no documented value so 14 is an explicit default; tick-based StopLossTicks/TakeProfitTicks and the fractal/position-permission switches are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Breakdown Catcher
strategy_roster.notes: Virtual levels are the previous bar's high/low, so a piercing high is the upside breakout and the pierced low is the exit; IndentPips 0 means no shift. StopLossPips 30, TakeProfitPips 90 and the 30-pip trailing stop are absolute pip distances and are not expressible as percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Monday Typical Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > (high + low + close) / 3 and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: The documented long trigger (session open above the previous bar's typical price) is translated as close above the bar's (high+low+close)/3 with a positive body, and the mirror cross exits. Monday/OpenHour 9 gating, equity lot scaling, and the 50/20 price-point stop and target are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Dominance Tagcloud
strategy_roster.notes: The document describes a crypto-dominance tag-cloud visualisation with explicitly no entry, exit or direction logic, so the impossible negative-price guard avoids fabricating a signal. Random box placement and multi-symbol drawing have no DSL equivalent.

strategy_roster.name: Pedro Mod
strategy_roster.notes: The contrarian first entry (price must move Gap away from the reference before buying) is represented by a 1% one-bar drop against the previous close, with the mirrored 1% rise as the exit; 1% is an explicit default because no Gap value is documented. Basket averaging via ReEntryGap, MaxTrades caps, pip stops and the hour window are not single-signal fields.

strategy_roster.name: BuySellStopButtons
strategy_roster.notes: The EA only trades on manual BuyRequest/SellRequest/CloseRequest button presses and the one-minute bar is a pure heartbeat, so no deterministic entry exists and the impossible negative-price guard is used. Money/percent take-profit, equity trailing lock, break-even and pip trailing are portfolio or percent fields the engine cannot express here.
